text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Messiah got injured during training,
so I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Fortunately, they say it's just minor injuries.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, I have a return-to-training menu prepared
just for occasions like this."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I am calculating the workload distribution and schedule.
Modifications to the training regimen have also been factored in.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I still have my daily routine training left to do.
And my next race as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Doing nothing is out of the question.
choice_data_list: Rest is important, too, you know.
Let's try doing just what Messiah says.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Doing nothing is out of the question.
choice_data_list: Rest is important, too, you know.
Let's try doing just what Messiah says.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Then I shall take a rest.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Of course. Rest is part of training, after all.
And above all...
because you, my revered mentor, said so."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Air Messiah dedicated herself
to recovering from her injury.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...I am so sorry.
It seems I made a slight error in my adjustments.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because Air Messiah's injury had worsened,
we decided to have her take a break for a while.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Make sure not to push yourself too hard.
...Make sure not to get hurt.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, better safe than sorry.
I'm glad I prepared a training list.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, by continuing with lighter training,
a smooth comeback was achieved.
